title: Particle Mass and Quantum Wavelength
question: How are invariant mass, rest energy, momentum, Compton scale, and de Broglie wavelength related without conflating them?
summary: Compare leptons, nucleons, nuclei, and atomic-mass scales while keeping massive-particle rest energy E_0 = mc^2, Compton scale h/(mc), and state-dependent de Broglie wavelength h/p distinct. Linked axes show derived values rather than independent measurements, momentum is not another form of invariant mass, and composite particles require different interpretation from elementary particles.

caveats: Derived linked-axis values are not independent observations.
